description: A village delivers mail to nearby villages either by runners or canoers. Runners can carry three bags of mail each time and takes 4 hours. Canoers can carry ten bags of mail each time and takes 2 hours. At most 33% of deliveries can be by canoe. Additionally, the village can spare at most 200 total hours and at least 4 runners must be used. How many of each way to deliver must be used to maximize the total amount of mail that can be delivered?

RunnerCapacity.definition: Number of bags a runner can carry each trip

RunnerTime.definition: Time a runner takes per trip (in hours)

CanoeCapacity.definition: Number of bags a canoeer can carry each trip

CanoeTime.definition: Time a canoeer takes per trip (in hours)

MaxCanoePercentage.definition: Maximum fraction of total deliveries that can be made by canoe

MaxTotalHours.definition: Maximum total hours the village can spare for deliveries

MinRunners.definition: Minimum number of runners that must be used

objective.description: "Maximize the total amount of mail (number of bags) delivered by runners and canoers"

constraints.description: 4 * (number of runner trips) + 2 * (number of canoe trips) <= MaxTotalHours
(number of canoe trips) <= MaxCanoePercentage * ((number of runner trips) + (number of canoe trips))
(number of runner trips) and (number of canoe trips) are integers

runnerTrips.definition: Number of runner trips used for mail delivery

canoeTrips.definition: Number of canoe trips used for mail delivery
